purpose: Semantic convergence queue. Items are behaviors/oracles still needing clean ownership, proof or explicit rejection; branch refs are provenance inputs, not work-item identity.

items.question: Do all rendering/read/copy/blit operations fail closed with GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION before native lowering when the relevant FBO is incomplete, including zero-work calls?
items.exit_condition: port/rebase the current semantic delta onto current integration, add/retain a focused negative oracle, and close with latest-head shared/backend proof

items.question: Does the clean host/presentation implementation already contain every unique iOS/Amethyst runtime-isolation invariant from this source ref?
items.exit_condition: compare unique source/test delta against current clean host contract and either transplant missing invariants or record exact containment

items.question: Should VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32 be represented as depth-only rather than depth/stencil in the relevant Vulkan format/aspect path?
items.exit_condition: build a focused aspect/readback oracle, compare clean Vulkan behavior, then transplant or reject the legacy rule with evidence

items.question: Is the current 32-bit normalized integer vertex path semantically correct via shader-side conversion, or must unsupported combinations fail closed?
items.exit_condition: add a focused value-level oracle covering normalization and both backends, then preserve the proven policy

items.question: Which complete GL_PACK/UNPACK row/image/skip, PBO shadow and BGRA/RGBA readback semantics proven in the legacy GUI lineage are still missing from the clean shared/Vulkan path?
items.exit_condition: enumerate semantic delta against clean tree, port only missing shared/Vulkan behavior with focused transfer/readback oracles, then mark source refs provenance-only

items.question: Which default-framebuffer orientation, Y-flip, BGRA and GUI/text presentation invariants from the legacy iOS path must exist at the clean Vulkan presentation seam?
items.exit_condition: transplant a clean orientation/presentation oracle first, then port only behavior it proves and close with exact-subject Minecraft/host evidence

items.question: Which descriptor/UBO alignment, staging and resource-lifetime findings from the legacy GUI lineage represent real semantic requirements rather than discarded hypotheses?
items.exit_condition: map each experiment outcome to a stable invariant or rejection, create backend-neutral identity where appropriate, and leave only reusable oracles/code

items.question: Which vertex/index/UV/interface and single-MoltenVK shader findings are still unique to legacy DirectVulkan and should be expressed in shared shader/lowering contracts?
items.exit_condition: compare clean shader/draw oracles to the legacy failures, transplant only missing semantics, and record rejected hypotheses

items.question: What minimum reusable real-Minecraft DirectVulkan oracle and diagnostics should live in the clean evidence plane without carrying one-off candidate workflows?
items.exit_condition: extract a stable exact-subject E2E oracle/diagnostic contract into clean CI or scripts, then retire branch-local trigger machinery as provenance
